title: Anti-atherosclerotic effects of Thymus quinquecostatus Celak extracts in vitro: Regulating macrophage foaming and endothelial cell injury.
authors: Song, Huixin; Yu, Jinjin; Li, Lingli; Fan, Heping; Zhang, Yarong; Ma, Yajing; Luo, Yuzhi; Zhang, Dezhu; Meng, Jianguo; Li, Weifeng; Niu, Xiaofeng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究百里香提取物抗动脉粥样硬化作用，涉及细胞实验和分子对接，但核心是植物药理学而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: Atherosclerosis (AS) serves as a critical pathological basis for cardiovascular diseases (CVDs), imposing significant global healthcare and economic burdens. Thymus quinquecostatus Celak (TQC), a versatile natural plant with medicinal, edible, ornamental, and environmental protection applications, has demonstrated cardiovascular protective effects. However, the potential anti-atherosclerotic mechanisms of TQC have not been reported. This study aimed to screen and compare extracts of TQC against AS, and reveal potential active molecules and mechanisms. The fingerprints of five extracts in TQC were established by HPLC-UV. The anti-AS potential of each extract of TQC was evaluated through a macrophage foaming model, identifying TQC ethanol extract (TEE) as the most effective extract in reducing lipid accumulation, suppressing inflammation, improving oxidative stress and mitophagy. Subsequently, the capacity of TEE to inhibit endothelial dysfunction was validated in an endothelial cell injury model, including ameliorating inflammation, cell adhesion, oxidative stress and mitophagy. Mechanistic investigations revealed that TEE's dual-cell protective effects involve the modulation of the Nrf2/HO-1/PINK1/Parkin signaling axis. Molecular docking studies further identified scutellarein as the most potent compound among those identified by TEE, exhibiting the strongest binding interactions with key therapeutic targets. Collectively, this study provides a theoretical foundation for developing TQC as a cardioprotective therapeutic candidate, offering references for its pharmacological investigations.
abstract_zh: 动脉粥样硬化（atherosclerosis, AS）是心血管疾病（cardiovascular diseases, CVDs）的关键病理基础，给全球医疗系统和经济带来了沉重负担。百里香（Thymus quinquecostatus Celak, TQC）作为一种兼具药用、食用、观赏及环保应用的多功能天然植物，已显示出心血管保护作用。然而，TQC潜在的抗动脉粥样硬化机制尚未见报道。本研究旨在筛选并比较TQC不同提取物对AS的作用，揭示潜在活性分子及其作用机制。通过HPLC-UV建立了TQC五种提取物的指纹图谱。利用巨噬细胞泡沫化模型评估TQC各提取物的抗AS潜力，确定TQC乙醇提取物（TQC ethanol extract, TEE）在减少脂质积累、抑制炎症、改善氧化应激和线粒体自噬方面最为有效。随后，在内皮细胞损伤模型中验证了TEE抑制内皮功能障碍的能力，包括改善炎症、细胞黏附、氧化应激和线粒体自噬。机制研究表明，TEE的双细胞保护作用涉及调节Nrf2/HO-1/PINK1/Parkin信号轴。分子对接研究进一步鉴定出野黄芩素（scutellarein）为TEE中鉴定出的最有效化合物，与关键治疗靶点表现出最强的结合相互作用。综上，本研究为开发TQC作为心脏保护治疗候选药物提供了理论基础，并为其药理学研究提供了参考。
